ratios.quote: the Consolidated Leverage Ratio required to be maintained was increased to not exceed 4.25 to 1.00 as of the end of the quarter ended September 25, 2026 and will remain at that level for the succeeding three fiscal quarters
minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio of not less than 2.25 to 1.00 as of the end of any fiscal quarter

parsed.notes: The filing gives no actual ratio values; it says only that the company was in compliance with all covenants as of September 25, 2026. The base maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio is 3.75x. It was temporarily raised to 4.25x because of the March 19, 2026 Del Monte Foods acquisition. Excluded: the 2.75x pro forma accordion test, the 3.50x dividend and repurchase basket tests, and the pricing grid ratios.
